assay.material: Source-described natural rutile, average powder diameter 40 micrometres; no specimen locality, bulk purity or XRD phase-purity determination supplied in accepted article/SI.
assay.coating: 0.54 g mineral plus 0.06 g acetylene black, approximately 0.3 mL PTFE and ethanol; 5 by 7 cm graphite, approximately 0.2 mm film, 12 h air drying.
assay.reactor: Two 350 mL glass chambers, proton exchange membrane, external wire and 1000 ohm resistor; mineral and microbes spatially separate.
assay.medium: P chamber: 12.5 g/L ascorbic acid, 2.5 g/L KCl. C chamber: m9K with 41.7 g/L FeSO4·7H2O; remaining nutrients on primary page 7. Final inoculum 3.5e5 cells/mL, 10% v/v.
assay.conditions: Near 30 degrees C, plus/minus 1 degree C; magnetic stirring and sterile ambient O2/CO2 inlet. Isolation medium adjusted to pH 2.2 plus/minus 0.02; reactor pH trajectory unspecified. Cultivation at 150 rpm is not claimed as reactor speed. Figure 2: four days, 380-760 nm, approximately 13.5 mW/cm2. Figure 4: 420/470/520/570/620 nm at 8 mW/cm2, with separate 420 nm intensity assay from 2 to 16 mW/cm2.
assay.analysis: Microscopy cell counts; o-phenanthroline Fe(II); current from voltage; optical absorption spectrum. Not a Ti extraction assay.
assay.controls: Dark biotic, mineral-free biotic labelled also open circuit, no-cell assay with Fe(II) replaced by Fe(III). Figure S2 has additional cell-free rutile-free and dark curves. Ascorbate used throughout.
assay.outcome: Conditional sustained growth associated with photocurrent and iron cycling; declining growth at 16 versus 8 mW/cm2. No numerical fold factor, current-density efficiency or isolated Ti yield adopted.
assay.scale: Laboratory; no field or industrial deployment.

limitations: Figure 2 combines rutile-free and open-circuit labels; Methods do not explicitly state circuit status. Separate effects cannot be cleanly assigned.
The Figure 2 caption gives about fivefold without a specified time-point denominator; no quantitative enhancement factor adopted.
The no-cell control changes initial iron speciation/concentration. Figure S2 labels its axis Fe(III), although the experiment is discussed for Fe(II) generation.
SI page 8 alternates oxidation of Fe(II) and reduction of Fe(III) wording. The page 9 equation DOES multiply oxygen-consumption rate by 60 h; no missing time conversion inferred.
Figure 4b current-density axis is mA/m2; Figure 4d is mA/cm2. SI uses C-chamber graphite area, whereas main prose uses rutile-electrode area. Quantitative current density not adopted.
SI page 10 describes roughly 3500 and then 2531 mg/L medium Fe(II) consumption for the 36-96 h interval. Model efficiencies not adopted.
The 2.1 micrograms/L Ti(IV) concentration is calculated, not measured leaching. No Ti mass balance.
Exact replicate counts and error-bar definitions for rutile curves are not provided; multiple experiments are asserted without raw replicate data.
Soil-community experiment uses applied voltage to simulate illumination in the absence of sunlight; Table S1 light/dark heading and voltage labels refer to that separate experiment.
Natural-mineral coating locality/purity remain unspecified; direct microbial colonization of rutile is not demonstrated.
